objective.claim: develop a separately attributable automated strategy that beats exact V8

source_inputs.role: raw price observations only; prior family hypotheses, labels, candidate ranks and economic results are excluded
source_inputs.post_2026_08_01_rows: excluded from every design, fit, calibration, selection and confirmation result

causal_decision_clock.decision: first executable tick of each newly opened common server H1 bar
causal_decision_clock.available_features: only bars completed strictly before the decision H1 open
causal_decision_clock.entry_proxy: common H1 open at the decision timestamp with direction-specific spread charged

per_symbol: log close return over 1 completed bar
log close return over 2 completed bars
log close return over 4 completed bars
log close return over 8 completed bars
log close return over 24 completed bars
prior body divided by prior 24-bar ATR
prior high-low range divided by prior 24-bar ATR
prior close location in prior high-low range
log tick-volume z-score against the prior 24 bars
prior recorded spread price divided by prior 24-bar ATR
cross_index: each symbol 1-bar return minus the three-symbol mean
each symbol 4-bar return minus the three-symbol mean
features.nonfinite_feature_policy: drop the decision row before prediction

target.per_symbol: next common H1 open-to-open price movement divided by the 24-bar ATR available at the decision

model.calibration_process: fit on the earlier part of the causal window, predict the final three months, pool absolute predictions across symbols, freeze density quantiles, then refit each symbol on the complete causal window

candidate_bundle.common_selection: at each decision choose only the executable symbol with the largest absolute predicted normalized movement
candidate_bundle.cost_awareness: predicted absolute normalized movement must be at least two times the current recorded spread price divided by the frozen ATR

position_and_proxy_execution.stop_distance: 1.5 times the 24-bar ATR frozen at decision
position_and_proxy_execution.maximum_hold: first executable tick of the next common H1 bar
position_and_proxy_execution.volume_rounding: floor target-risk volume to the 0.01 step; use minimum 0.01 only when planned stop loss is at most 4% of current balance; otherwise skip
position_and_proxy_execution.stressed_cost: two times the recorded direction-specific round-trip spread
position_and_proxy_execution.stop_detection: adverse H1 high or low crossing of the exact spread-aware protective level; stop is always adverse so no same-bar take-profit ordering exists

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete gate passers, tie lower drawdown then higher minimum yearly stressed net

native_escalation.condition: exactly one unchanged proxy role passes development, locked confirmation and whole proxy challenge gates
native_escalation.tester_model: FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks with 100% real ticks

stop_rules.no_development_passer: close V1 without opening 2026 confirmation, EA implementation or MT5; recompare and design a materially distinct adapter architecture
stop_rules.confirmation_or_whole_proxy_failure: close V1 without EA or MT5 and do not rescue an adjacent density quantile or model hyperparameter
stop_rules.native_failure: close the complete V1 family; environment and engineering faults are corrected, but valid adverse economics are not retuned inside V1
stop_rules.success: record a verified V8 challenge victory; Live remains unchanged and any deployment requires a separate user-authorized engineering and Live decision
